definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine dealing with the musculoskeletal system, including bones, joints, and muscles. In Japanese, this term refers specifically to orthopedics, not cosmetic surgery.

examples.japanese: {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the orthopedic clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I visited orthopedics because my lower back hurts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦レントゲン→レントゲン：11219_rentogen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}って→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Since there was a possibility of a fracture, I had an X-ray taken at orthopedics.

notes:
The medical specialty dealing with bones, joints, muscles, and the musculoskeletal system. In Japanese, {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか} refers specifically to orthopedics (bones and joints), not cosmetic surgery.

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION:
Do not confuse with ⟦{美容|びよう}{整形|せいけい}→美容整形：20905_biyouseikei⟧ (cosmetic surgery). Despite both containing ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧, they are completely different fields. When Japanese people say they are going to {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}, they mean the bone doctor, not a plastic surgeon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to visit an orthopedic clinic
- {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}{医|い}: orthopedic surgeon
- {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}{専門医|せんもんい}: orthopedic specialist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧ — surgery (general); the broader surgical field
- ⟦{接骨院|せっこついん}→接骨院：20981_sekkotsuin⟧ — bonesetter's clinic (traditional, non-surgical treatment)
- ⟦{美容|びよう}{整形|せいけい}→美容整形：20905_biyouseikei⟧ — cosmetic surgery (different field entirely)
